title: Maximal Multipoint Seshadri Constants in Higher Dimensions
summary: Let L be an ample line bundle on a smooth integral complex projective variety X of dimension n ≥ 3. We prove that there is a threshold $`r_0=r_0(X,L)`$ such that for every integer $`r\ge r_0`$, the ordinary multipoint Seshadri constant at r very general points equals the volume bound $`(L^n/r)^{1/n}`$. This establishes the qualitative Nagata–Biran–Szemberg assertion in these dimensions.
family_title: Nagata’s conjecture and maximal Seshadri constants

review.reason: Shows multipoint Seshadri constants reach the volume bound for large point counts in higher dimensions.
